# receiveLM

> receiveLM is an AI agent that answers business phone calls 24/7 for a flat monthly price, with no per-minute billing.

## What it does
- Answers inbound business calls instantly, day or night
- Books appointments, checks calendars, answers FAQs
- Escalates urgent calls to a live person based on custom rules
- Transcribes and summarizes every call, delivered to inbox/CRM/Slack

## Pricing
- Starter: $99/month flat, single line, full coverage
- Custom: multi-line, multi-location, custom CRM integrations
